issues.description: The return type of Stock.getStockIngredients differs between the template and the solution. In the template, getStockIngredients() returns a List<StockIngredient>, while in the solution it returns StockIngredient[]. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended API (array vs. list) and may cause compilation or integration issues when following examples in Main or when implementing SealSaloon.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the getStockIngredients() signature across template and solution. Prefer returning StockIngredient[] (to match setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]) and ArrayHelpers usage) or update both to consistently return List<StockIngredient>. Make the same change in both template and solution so students see a single consistent API.
